parsed.why: Worst-tier division: birth-certificate changes near-closed forcing outing via documents, facility-use restriction in state-run buildings, sports bans, care ban, no state protections; layered on a hostile national regime.

Low-risk tier: gender-identity anti-discrimination operating since 2018, X licences, sanctuary-city care shielding; no local facility ban. Sports bills stalled. Above the parent, still under national document/screening exposure.

Low-risk tier with no local ban, but the operative facility restriction is imposed by the national legislature and cannot be locally repealed; protections overrideable — thin local mitigation of the national regime.

Veto-overridden statutes: K-12 facility ban, minors' care ban, sports ban, religious-freedom override route; hate-crime statute excludes gender identity. Mostly student/resident-facing, but state hostility layer sits atop national regime.

Most Protective tier: gender-identity public-accommodations law affirmed by popular vote, hate-crime coverage, X documents, care shield law protecting travelling patients; unenforced sodomy relics are tangential. Well above parent.
